examples.text: 원래 한편 뒤에 진짜 하고 싶은 말 하잖아요.
examples.trans: People always put what they actually want to say right after "Meanwhile," you know.

examples.text: 요즘 불만이 극에 달해 있어요, 우리가 단체 행동을 해서 버릇을 고쳐놔야 돼!
examples.trans: Complaints have reached a boiling point lately—we need collective action to fix that attitude!
Here the word for 'action' is key.
Current time.
Current situation.
I ate alone today.
I can do it well by myself too.

meanings.note: Can also function as a noun
